links.outcome: Expert-graded adequacy of chatbot answers to heart failure questions, including contemporary recommendations
links.effect: ChatGPT appropriate in 27/30 (90%); Bard 23/30 (77%). Both had hallucinated facts and/or difficulty with more contemporary recommendations.
links.quote: Both platforms suffered from issues related to “hallucination” of facts and/or difficulty with more contemporary recommendations.

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT content across repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: ChatGPT showed a high degree of consistency (93%); Bard provided similar content in its answers.
links.quote: ChatGPT provided mostly appropriate answers (27/30, 90%) and showed a high degree of consistency (93%).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT-3.5 and Google Bard in answering 30 patient questions regarding heart failure, assessed by expert clinicians.
